notes: Spectral response functions of METimage (Visible/Infrared Imager, VII) on Metop-SG A1 (EUMETSAT), from the EUMETSAT NWP SAF RTTOV spectral-response-function page rtcoef_metopsg_1_metimage_srf.html (https://nwp-saf.eumetsat.int/site/software/rttov/download/coefficients/spectral-response-functions/); the owner's own file is not available online (see Sources). NWP SAF README: 'This file generated: 02/09/2026 README SRF: README file for METimage SRFs for METimage for MetOP-SG A1 Date: August 2026 file EPS-SGA1-METIMAGE_SRF_V10.nc (Low_Res) Pre-processing of SRFs: SRFs values normalized with between 0. and 1. Visible channel : 0.443 0.555 0.668 0.752 0.763 0.865 0.914 1.240 1.375 1.630 2.250 IR channel: 3.740 micron 3.959 micron 4.050 micron 6.725 micron 7.325 micron 8.540 micron 10.690 micron 12.020 micron 13.345 micron'. Converted from wavenumber (cm-1) to wavelength (Angstrom, lambda = 1e8/sigma) and sorted; negative samples set to 0; scaled to peak 1. DetectorType=energy is assumed: the owner gives a normalised (relative) spectral response without stating photon or energy weighting; meteorological imager SRFs are applied as weights on spectral radiance (energy convention). SVO's archived records for these instruments carry DetectorType 0 (energy). Source: EUMETSAT, via the EUMETSAT NWP SAF.
